problems.reason: Both sentences state that Australovenator was a relatively lightweight predator.

Sentence 21 states Australovenator lived in the Cenomanian stage (~95 Ma), while sentence 23 says the holotype was recovered from the lower part of the Winton Formation dated to the late Albian, which is earlier than the Cenomanian.
Sentence 1 gives a mass range of 310–500 kg, while sentence 7 describes Australovenator as a lightweight predator nicknamed the ‘cheetah of its time’, implying a much lighter build.
Both sentences state the taxonomic placement of Australovenator within Megaraptora/Megaraptoridae, repeating the same classification claim.
Sentences 20–22 describe the Winton Formation’s sedimentology and the climate of the habitat, which are about the environment rather than the animal itself.
